subject.title: fix(qa-lab): add live turn timeout env override

question: Should OpenClaw support `OPENCLAW_QA_LIVE_TURN_TIMEOUT_MS` as a central, raise-only QA Lab fallback override that can also raise mock-provider turn fallbacks?
rationale: The patch is mechanically bounded and preserves existing provider floors, but adding and documenting a process-wide operator configuration contract—and its intended scope across QA provider modes—is product policy rather than a purely mechanical bug repair.

options.title: Accept the shared fallback contract
options.body: Merge the PR with the documented raise-only behavior for both live-frontier and mock-provider resolution paths.

options.title: Constrain the override to live-frontier
options.body: Revise the resolver, tests, variable name, and docs so mock-provider fallback resolution is unaffected.

options.title: Decline a new environment surface
options.body: Keep provider-family floors as the only supported control and close the PR as an unaccepted configuration direction.

recommendation.title: Accept the shared fallback contract
recommendation.body: Merge the PR with the documented raise-only behavior for both live-frontier and mock-provider resolution paths.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the clearest recent merged and proposed history in the QA Lab timeout path, though the final configuration-contract decision belongs to the repository's QA Lab owners.
